openings.claim: Cross-reaching interrupts picking, producing omissions. Local loose materials explain O4's clean batch despite abandoning shared trays.
openings.delta: Tray tags identify types and samples show contents; neither prevents interrupted picks.
openings.prediction: With pattern totals and order matched, local placement reduces crossings and omissions; blocking pattern order adds little.
openings.rival_prediction: Pattern-quantity confusion predicts blocking pattern order matters more than placement. O4 could have involved fewer switches, but its mixture is unknown.
openings.defeat: Omissions persist after crossings disappear, yet decline when pattern order is blocked.
openings.probe: One 24-kit factorial probe: shared/local placement crossed with blocked/interleaved order, six kits per cell, two of each pattern. Keep tags and samples equally accessible; counterbalance volunteer and cell order. Tally crossings, omissions before correction, and elapsed time; correct immediately. Cap at 35 minutes within the total 90-minute budget; use existing supplies and table only.
assumptions: Local layouts fit the existing table; verify before proceeding.
This evaluates a bounded probe, not proven 60-kit success.
All supplied observations are synthetic stipulations.

openings.claim: Switching patterns confuses quantities of shared materials; material-type tags cannot encode the current pattern's requirements. O4's clean result could reflect fewer switches, an unconfirmed explanation.
openings.delta: The scarce sample consultations leave pattern-specific quantity recall doing the work.
openings.prediction: Blocking pattern order reduces omissions in both placements; local placement alone leaves interleaved-pattern omissions despite fewer crossings.
openings.rival_prediction: Interruption from cross-reaching predicts local placement reduces omissions under either pattern order, with little additional blocking benefit.
openings.defeat: Local placement eliminates omissions under interleaved order while blocking alone leaves omissions in shared placement.
openings.probe: Use the same bounded 24-kit four-condition probe specified in A1; the discriminating observation is whether omissions track placement or pattern order after crossings are tallied.
assumptions: O4's pattern mixture and switching frequency remain unknown.
Local-layout table fit requires verification; no constraint relaxation is allowed.
Neither mechanism establishes readiness of all 60 correct, assigned kits within 90 minutes.
